activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast
Getting dressed, tidying the room and checking the day's schedule on the phone
Reading work emails, replying to gallery and grant correspondence and planning the day's arts administration tasks at the desk
Working at the desk on arts administration duties and illustrating commissioned pieces on the computer and monitor
Cooking a light lunch on the induction cooker and eating it
Taking a short break, watching TV and stretching
Continuing afternoon illustration work and colour studies at the desk
Preparing and cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker
Eating dinner and clearing the dishes into the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
Taking a shower with hot water and doing evening skincare
Personal sketching practice and reading under the desk lamp, with the space heater on
